brief.ask: Create the brand family for Lumenfold, the office suite in this monorepo: the Lumenfold master brand and product icons for Lumenfold Docs, Sheets and Sign.
brief.owner: Owner preferences: privacy-first and European, calm and precise. The three product icons must clearly belong to one family and still be told apart at small sizes. Web apps only.

claim.notes: All three directions (crease-light, folded-disc, ribbon-l) received sketch-pick 'none' from the critic in two rounds and were rejected, so no concept reached develop, the quality gate, finalize, export or the gallery.

concepts.title: Lit Crease
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 toilet/boot; s2 open lid; s3 flag or boot; s4 clipboard with folded corner (page cliche); s5 hinged flap; s6 stacked drawers; s7 boot/hockey stick; s8 wallet or envelope. No fold or light idea reads; all are two blobs. Drop direction.

concepts.title: Folded Disc
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 peeling sticker; s2 swirl/yin-yang cookie; s3 peeled sticker or moon; s4 crescent moon with a slice; s5 smiley. Peeling sticker or page curl is a known UI/app-icon idiom, says nothing about privacy or suite, and only the single big wedge survives 16 px. Drop.

concepts.title: Folded Ribbon L
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 brochure or map; s2 warning triangle or Delta; s3 flag or T; s4 open book; s5 play button on a book. Open book and play are clichés, the triangle is a known logo shape, and no L or fold idea is ownable. Drop.
